author: emilygraceillustration
title: Storyboard Artist Wanted for Animatic
content: STORYBOARD ARTIST WANTED! 🎬 I'm looking for a talented freelance storyboard artist to collaborate on a short proof-of-concept animatic for an original animated action-adventure series. I'm particularly keen to hear from artists who specialise in dynamic action sequences, cinematic composition and strong character moments. This is a paid opportunity for a small, creator-led project. author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists and More
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️ We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. These positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships. If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with the following information: -Name, general location -Position applying for -Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples -Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-) -Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary) -Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work -Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc) -Preferred Payment Method (However, PayPal is what we will use) -Other notable experience / specializations *NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE* ‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️

author: mrcharlesky
title: Hiring Graphic Artist for Game Content
content: Hiring: 🎨 GRAPHIC ARTIST AND 📸 VIDEO EDITOR! Job Title: Graphic Artist (Freelance) The Role: You will work closely with our social media manager. We are not only looking for someone with a sharp eye for design but also someone meticulous with text placement (such as CTA) and image compositions that convert viewers into followers, players, wishlisters, etc. Moreover, we need someone who is proactive with design suggestions and reflects brand elements surrounding Philippine culture & tradition incorporated into our games. Key Responsibilities: - Create game content poster layouts and graphic images for social media use. Use digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout software to create designs. - Collaborate with the social media team and production team to develop creative solutions. -Follow brand guidelines, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and revision feedback efficiently. SEND YOUR CV & PORTFOLIO to: support@dalluyonstudio.com
